text:
nina: Quick sync - I'm drafting the token-broker + policy runtime RFC. Main targets: (1) minting patterns for svc-to-svc, (2) route-level policy evaluation, (3) cache invalidation semantics. Thoughts?
li: Love it. Question: do we embed policy evaluation into the runtime (fast path) or call an external policy evaluator (Rego/OPA)?
raj: Perf is huge here. Per-request external calls add latency. If we go OPA, push a compiled bundle into the edge proxies and runtime, eval locally. Bundle updates via signed artifacts.

nina: Agreed on bundles. Proposal: token-broker returns a signed JWT + a policy-hash claim. Runtime verifies signature + looks up local policy cache by hash. If hash unknown, fall back to introspection.
tom: That implies we need good bundle distribution + atomic swap. Also a TTL on the policy-hash in tokens so old tokens don't depend on removed policies forever.
li: TTL on tokens is fine. Recommendation: max token TTL = 1h for service tokens; 24h for long-lived org keys (only for integration use).

nina: Example token payload (for RFC):
```
{
  "iss": "redwood-auth",
  "sub": "svc-ingest-42",
  "aud": "ingest-runtime",
  "exp": 1610000000,
  "pol_hash": "sha256:abcd1234",
  "claims": {"project":"proj-99","roles":["writer"]}
}
```

raj: Policy bundle format (sketch):
```
policies/
  runtime.allow.rego
  metadata.yaml   # bundle_id, version, signed_by
```
metadata.yaml example: `bundle_id: blobs/pol-2026-03-01, signer: redwood-auth, sig: ...`

li: For runtime rule lookup, what if route-level config forbids org-scoped tokens by default? We should make runtime config per-route: `allow_org_keys: false` and `require_project_claim: true`.
tom: Yeah, route-level opt-in for cross-org calls. Important for internal admin routes we can explicitly allow org-role:admin.

nina: Invalidation: when a policy changes to revoke a role, tokens previously minted with old policy must either expire quickly or be introspected. Two controls: short TTL + an admin revocation list (RRL) keyed by token id. Runtime caches RRL entries with small TTLs.

raj: RRL introduces storage/loading headaches. Alternative: include `issued_at` and `policy_version`. Runtime rejects tokens with policy_version < route.min_accepted_version. That pushes the decision to the platform when rolling versions.
li: Good idea. policy_version let us do gradual rollouts: bump min_accepted_version in route config, and creatives can epoch older tokens out.

nina: Implementation tasks I see:
- token-broker: sign tokens, include pol_hash & policy_version
- bundle service: compile + sign policy bundles, expose signed artifacts
- runtime: local policy cache, verify signature, eval policy fast-path, fallback introspect API
- sdk: helper tools to request project-scoped tokens & a migration notifier for org-key use

tom: Ops notes: cache policy bundles on edge proxy + runtime, invalidate via signed bundle_id. Cache TTL should be aligned with token TTL to avoid skews.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: token-broker v0.8 canary started at 3174524200 :rocket:

raj: Telemetry: emit metrics for `token_verification_time`, `policy_eval_time`, `introspect_calls` and `tokens_rejected_missing_policy`. We'll gate rollout on low introspect rate.
li: For the RFC include minimal config snippets: route YAML example and a sample Rego rule.

nina: Rego snippet for allow rule (RFC):
```
package runtime.authz

allow {
  input.claims.project == input.route.project
  some role
  role == input.claims.roles[_]
  role_allowed(role, input.route)
}

role_allowed(role, route) {
  # lookup in route.policy table
  role == "writer"
  route.allow_write == true
}
```

ops-bot: NOTE: canary progress: token-broker v0.8 reported 0 errors at 3174524499 :white_check_mark:

nina: Next steps: I'll fold this into an RFC draft with sections: motivation, token format, policy bundle lifecycle, runtime rules, migration path & telemetry. Aim to post PR by EOD Friday.
li: I'll add the Rego examples + CLI to publish bundles.
raj: I'll prepare the rollout playbook (circuit-breakers, metrics gates, rollback steps).
tom: SDKs will add migration telemetry and a helper to exchange org-key -> temporary project token.

nina: Thanks y'all. If no objections, I'll label RFC `authz/token-broker-compact` and link ops + sdks. @tom please ping when helper is ready. :thumbsup:
